This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)

- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). ## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

34	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
35	
36	### 4.1 检测门的判定：`registry.detect` 与三种结果
37	
38	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
39	
40	「检测门」是 `main()` 在读完 `config.json` 之后、做任何昂贵动作（引擎加载）之前的一步裁决：**这份配置到底归哪条编译进来的模型线管？**
41	
42	设计约束写在 `probe` 的契约里：**恰好一条线必须接受一份给定配置**。由此产生三种结果：
43	
44	1. **唯一认领**：恰好一条线 `probe` 返回 `Ok` → 检测通过，返回这条线的 `&'static dyn ModelLine`，`main()` 继续往下走。
45	2. **`Conflict`**：两条线都返回 `Ok` → 这是**注册表层面的 bug**（两条线的身份表重叠了），必须立刻失败并点名双方。

47	
48	`NoMatch` 还有一个特殊待遇：`main()` 会在它后面追加一条「feature 提示」（4.3 节）。

50	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
51	
52	`detect` 的判定循环可以写成这样的伪代码：
53	
54	```text
55	rejections = []
56	claimed = None
57	for line in 编译进来的每条线（按注册顺序）:
58	    match line.probe(config):
59	        Ok  => if claimed 为空: claimed = line
60	               else:           立即返回 Conflict { first: 已占者, second: 后来者 }
61	        Err(reason) => rejections.push("{line.name}: {reason}")
62	claimed 存在 => 返回 claimed
63	否则 => 返回 NoMatch {
64	    model_type:     config.model_type（缺失则 "missing"）
65	    architectures:  config.architectures（缺失则 "missing"）
66	    rejections:     rejections 用 "; " 连接
67	}
68	```
69

71	
72	- `Conflict` **立刻返回**，不再继续探测——错误已经足够定性；
73	- `NoMatch` 则**收集完所有拒绝原因**才返回——信息量最大化，用户能看到每条线的说法。

78	
79	```rust
80	pub enum DetectError {
81	    #[error("model config claimed by both {first} and {second}")]
82	    Conflict { first: &'static str, second: &'static str },
83	    #[error(
84	        "no compiled-in model line claims this config (model_type={model_type}, architectures={architectures}); rejections: {}",
85	        rejections.join("; ")

87	    NoMatch { model_type: String, architectures: String, rejections: Vec<String> },
88	}
89	```

91	这段代码定义了检测失败的两类错误：`Conflict` 点名两条抢配置的线；`NoMatch` 渲染身份字段并拼接全部拒绝原因。其上方文档注释（L24-L26）明说了分工：**server 只在 `NoMatch` 上分支去追加 feature 提示，其余直接渲染**——这正是本讲 4.3 的接线点。

129	4. **预期结果**（由源码逐字段推导；精确排版待本地验证）：

131	   ```text

135	   逐段对账：`model_type=qwen3` 与 `architectures=["SomethingElse"]` 来自 `render` 闭包；`Qwen3: Qwen3 architectures must contain Qwen3ForCausalLM` 是 Qwen3 线的 `probe` 先过 `model_type` 预筛（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:L137-L141](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L137-L141)）、再在 [../pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs:L905-L908](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L905-L908) 的 `ensure!` 处失败给出的原因；错误里**没有** `--features` 提示——qwen3 是已编译的线，提示机制（4.3 节）只服务「存在但被编译掉」的家族。这与单测 `probe_rejects_bad_architectures`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:L436-L439](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L436-L439)）断言的是同一个行为。
136	
137	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
138	
139	**练习 1**：`Conflict` 什么时候出现？它是用户错误还是代码 bug？
140	
141	**答案**：两条注册线的 `probe` 对同一份 config 都返回 `Ok` 时出现（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:L577-L584](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L577-L584)）。用户无法通过换模型目录触发它——它说明两条模型线的身份表（各自认领的 `model_type` 集合）发生了重叠，属于注册表层面的 bug。以错误而非 panic 呈现，是因为它毕竟要在运行期被发现，且错误信息（点名双方）已足够定位。

151	### 4.2 `families()` 身份表：必要的第二真相源
152	
153	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
154	
155	4.1 节的 `detect` 只能调用**编译进来的**线的 `probe`。于是出现一个盲区：用户拿着一份 GLM5.2 的配置跑 stock 二进制（只编了 qwen3），`detect` 只会得到 `NoMatch`——**没有任何代码能告诉用户「其实项目支持这条线，你只是没编进去」**，因为 glm52 的 crate 根本不在这个二进制里，它的 `probe`、它的 `model_type` 字符串都不存在。
156	
157	解决办法是在 server 里维护一张**身份表** `families()`：每一行记录「feature 名 + 这条线的 `probe` 会认领哪些 `model_type`（顶层与 `text_config` 各一组）+ 这条线在本二进制里是否被编译」。文档注释给它定性：**a second source of truth by necessity**（必要的第二真相源）——「提示存在的意义恰恰是那条线（连同它的 `probe`）被编译掉的场合，所以这些字符串不可能从线 crate 里读出来」，只能硬编码在此。
158	
159	`compiled` 字段用 `cfg!(feature = "...")` 求值：这是**编译期常量**，随本二进制的 feature 集合而定——同一份 `main.rs`，stock 构建里 glm52 行的 `compiled` 是 `false`，`--features glm52` 构建里是 `true`。
160	
161	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
162	
163	表的每一行是一个四字段结构：
164	
165	```text
166	Family {
167	    feature:          cargo feature 名（也是提示里 --features 的参数）
168	    model_types:      该线 probe 认领的顶层 model_type 列表
169	    text_model_types: 该线 probe 认领的 text_config.model_type 列表
170	    compiled:         cfg!(feature = ...) —— 本二进制是否编入该线
171	}
172	```
173	
174	表在 `families()` 里按字母序列出全部 8 条线，返回定长数组 `[Family; 8]`。它的生命周期与维护纪律：
175	
176	- **新增模型线**必须同步加一行，否则「被编译掉的提示」对该线永远沉默（这是 u5-l2 接入清单的一项）；
177	- 返回类型是**定长数组**，行数写死在签名里——多写一行少写一行都会直接类型不匹配，但「整行忘了加」编译器管不着，只能靠测试兜底；
178	- 兜底测试的范例是 qwen4 行：`qwen4_hint_identity_matches_the_line_crate` 把表里的字符串与线 crate 自己的 `MODEL_TYPE`/`TEXT_MODEL_TYPE` 常量做相等断言，改了一边不改另一边就失败。

237	### 4.3 `feature_gate_hint()`：把身份翻译成 rebuild 建议
238	
239	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
240	
241	有了身份表，剩下的就是把「这份 config 属于某个**未编译**家族」翻译成一句可操作的建议。`feature_gate_hint(config)` 做的就是这件事：从 config 里取两个身份键（顶层 `model_type` 与 `text_config.model_type`），在 `families()` 里找**第一个**「未编译且身份匹配」的行，命中则返回一句固定格式的提示：
242	
243	```text
244	this looks like a {feature} model; rebuild pegainfer-server with --features {feature}
245	```
246	
247	它在 `main()` 里的接线位置（u1-l3 的阶段 6 内部）：`detect` 失败且**恰好是 `NoMatch`** 时，才把提示用 `"; "` 拼在原始错误后面一起返回；`Conflict` 或成功路径完全不经此分支。也就是说，最终用户看到的 `NoMatch` 错误是「判定细节 + 行动建议」两段式。
248	
249	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
250	
251	```text
252	feature_gate_hint(config):
253	    model_type      = config.model_type        （缺失则 ""）
254	    text_model_type = config.text_config.model_type（缺失则 ""）
255	    在 families() 里找第一行满足：
256	        !compiled
257	        且 (model_types 含 model_type 或 text_model_types 含 text_model_type)
258	    命中 => 返回 "this looks like a {feature} model; rebuild ... with --features {feature}"
259	    未命中 => 返回 None（未知家族 → 无提示）
260	```
261	
262	`main()` 侧的接线：
263	
264	```text
265	registry.detect(config) 失败 =>
266	    if 是 NoMatch 且 feature_gate_hint(config) 命中:
267	        返回错误 "{NoMatch 错误}; {hint}"
268	    else:
269	        原样返回错误
270	```
271	
272	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
273	
274	提示函数本体（[src/main.rs:L123-L144](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L123-L144)）：
275	
276	```rust
277	fn feature_gate_hint(config: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<String> {
278	    let model_type = config.get("model_type").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
279	    let text_model_type = config.get("text_config")
280	        .and_then(|text| text.get("model_type"))
281	        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
282	        .unwrap_or("");
283	    families().iter().find_map(|family| {
284	        (!family.compiled
285	            && (family.model_types.contains(&model_type)
286	                || family.text_model_types.contains(&text_model_type)))
287	        .then(|| format!(
288	            "this looks like a {} model; rebuild pegainfer-server with --features {}",
289	            family.feature, family.feature
290	        ))
291	    })
292	}
293	```
294	
295	这段代码先取两个身份键，再用 `find_map` 在身份表里找第一个未编译且身份匹配的行并格式化提示。注意 `find_map` 按 `families()` 的表序短路——理论上若多个未编译家族共享同一 `model_type`，只有表里靠前者会被提示（当前表无此重叠）。
296	
297	`main()` 的接线（[src/main.rs:L168-L175](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L168-L175)）：

299	```rust

301	    if matches!(error, DetectError::NoMatch { .. }) {
302	        if let Some(hint) = feature_gate_hint(&config) {
303	            return anyhow::anyhow!("{error}; {hint}");
304	        }
305	    }
306	    anyhow::Error::from(error)
307	})?;
308	```
309	
310	这段代码把提示的适用范围收窄到 `NoMatch` 一种情形：`Conflict` 是注册表 bug，与用户该重建什么无关；而 `NoMatch` 正是「可能拿了未编译家族的模型」的信号。提示以 `"; "` 拼接在判定错误之后，用户一次看到「为什么失败」与「怎么办」。

376	**练习 2**：`text_model_types` 这个查找键是为了什么场景存在的？
377	
378	**答案**：多模态模型的 config 常把文本塔参数嵌在 `text_config` 对象里，其 `model_type`（如 `gemma4_unified_text`、`qwen4_exp_text`）可能与顶层不同。只查顶层 `model_type` 会漏掉这类身份，所以身份表为每行多维护一组 `text_model_types`，`feature_gate_hint` 同时取 `text_config.model_type` 参与匹配（[src/main.rs:L128-L136](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L128-L136)）。单测 `hint_matches_text_config_identities` 专门断言这条通路。
379	
380	**练习 3**：stock 构建下用一份合法的 Qwen3-4B 配置运行，`feature_gate_hint` 会命中 qwen3 行吗？
381	
382	**答案**：不会。qwen3 行的 `compiled` 在 stock 构建下是 `true`，而匹配条件里有 `!family.compiled` 这一环——提示只服务「存在但被编译掉」的家族。合法 Qwen3 配置会在 `detect` 处被唯一认领，根本走不到错误分支；即便 config 有 `architectures` 之类的身份错误（4.1.4 实践），得到的也只是纯 `NoMatch`，无提示。
383	
384	### 4.4 `detect_gate` 集成测试：驱动真实二进制验证这道门
385	
386	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
387	
388	到 4.3 为止，检测门的每个部件（`probe`、`detect`、`families`、`feature_gate_hint`）都有自己的单测。但**部件正确 ≠ 接线正确**：`main()` 读 `config.json`、调 `registry.detect`、在 `NoMatch` 上拼提示、再到 `launch` 的拒绝——这条链路只有把二进制真的跑起来才会被执行。`tests/detect_gate.rs` 的模块文档（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L1-L11](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L1-L11)）开头就交代了这层动机，并点明它断言的是**两种出厂行为**：
389	
390	- **stock 构建**（未编 qwen4）：检测门对 `qwen4_exp` 配置给出「named feature」提示；
391	- **enabled 构建**（`--features qwen4`）：检测门放行，`launch` 明确拒绝服务（qwen4 尚未实现推理）。
392	
393	文档最后一句是关键承诺：**两条路径都不触达 CUDA**——检测是纯计算，`launch` 在引擎构建之前就 bail 了。这让这个端到端测试可以跑在没有 GPU 的 CI 机器上。
394	
395	选 qwen4 做探针是很讲究的：它是唯一一条「能通过 detect 但 launch 拒绝」的线，一个 fixture 就把门的**两侧**都测到了。
396	
397	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
398	
399	测试的组装流水线：
400	
401	```text
402	两个编译期 fixture:
403	    FROZEN_CONFIG = include_str!(../pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json)  ← 真 checkpoint 的冻结 config
404	    TOKENIZER     = include_str!(../pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-model/tokenizer.json) ← 仓库最小 tokenizer
405	
406	model_dir(tag):
407	    在 $TMP/pegainfer-detect-gate-{tag}-{pid} 下写 config.json + tokenizer.json
408	
409	run_against(dir):
410	    spawn $CARGO_BIN_EXE_pegainfer --model-path dir   ← 真二进制
411	    stderr 重定向到文件（防管道写满阻塞子进程）
412	    每 50ms try_wait 轮询；超过 60s 杀掉并 panic
413	
414	两个用例（按构建 feature 二选一编译）:
415	    #[cfg(not(feature = "qwen4"))] stock_build_names_the_qwen4_feature
416	        断言: 退出非成功 且 stderr 含 "--features qwen4"
417	    #[cfg(feature = "qwen4")]     enabled_build_detects_the_line_and_refuses_to_serve
418	        断言: 退出非成功 且 stderr 含 "Qwen4" 且 含 "not implemented"
419	```
420	
421	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
422	
423	**Fixture 一：冻结的真 config**（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L22-L27](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L22-L27)）。注释说明「server 自己不放 fixture，这道门就该看真东西」——这份文件由 qwen4 线 crate 提交，顶层 `model_type` 是 `"qwen4_exp"`（[../pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json:L7](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json#L7)），文本塔身份 `"qwen4_exp_text"` 在 [../pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json:L85](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json#L85)——恰好对应身份表 qwen4 行的两个键。
424	
425	**Fixture 二：最小 tokenizer 及其存在理由**（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L29-L37](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L29-L37)）。这段注释是全文件最值得一读的设计说明：enabled 构建里，`launch` 拒绝之前**HTTP 前端已经并发启动**（u1-l3 的双时间线），而前端没有 tokenizer 会拒绝启动——那样 stderr 里出现的就是 tokenizer 错误，把真正的 `launch` 拒绝**顶掉了**。放进 echo-model 的最小 BPE tokenizer（一份极小的词表文件，见 [../pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-model/tokenizer.json:L1-L27](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-model/tokenizer.json#L1-L27)），让前端正常起来、等引擎失败再把整个 server 拉倒，refusal 才是最终到达 stderr 的那个错误。
426	
427	**运行器**（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L39-L83](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L39-L83)）三个工程细节：
428	
429	- `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_pegainfer")` 编译期给出被测二进制路径——测试驱动的就是**出厂形态的那个 `pegainfer`**，不是库函数；
430	- stderr 写进**文件**再读回，注释写明「a full pipe cannot stall the child」：若用管道且测试侧不及时读，子进程把管道缓冲写满后会卡在 write 上永不退出；
431	- 50ms 一次 `try_wait` 轮询 + 60 秒上限（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L50-L52](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L50-L52)），注释说二进制暖机后一秒内就会退出，60 秒只是为了兜住「启动或取消路径永远不返回」的回归（比如引擎失败后 server 没被正确拉倒）。
432	
433	**两个用例**（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L85-L119](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L85-L119)）：stock 用例断言非成功退出 + stderr 含 `--features qwen4`；enabled 用例断言非成功退出 + stderr 含 `Qwen4`（来自 `main` 的 `=== pegainfer - Qwen4 (GPU) ===` 启动横幅与 `failed to start Qwen4 engine` 上下文）且含 `not implemented`（来自 [../pegainfer-qwen4/src/model_line.rs:L29-L31](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen4/src/model_line.rs#L29-L31) 的 `launch`：`anyhow::bail!("this qwen4_exp checkpoint is detected, but inference is not implemented yet")`）。两个测试各自被互斥的 `#[cfg]` 守卫——同一份代码，构建决定谁上场。
434	
435	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
436	
437	**目标**：分别以 stock 与 enabled 两种构建跑这个集成测试，体会「同一份测试代码、两种出厂行为」，并说清两种断言各自验证什么。
438	
439	1. stock 路径（无需 GPU；需可完成 CUDA 工具链编译——这是构建期依赖，不是运行期）：
440	
441	   ```bash
442	   cargo test --release -p pegainfer-server --test detect_gate
443	   ```
444	
445	2. enabled 路径：
446	
447	   ```bash
448	   cargo test --release -p pegainfer-server --features qwen4 --test detect_gate
449	   ```
450	
451	3. **观察现象**：两次都应看到 1 个测试通过（`stock_build_names_the_qwen4_feature` 或 `enabled_build_detects_the_line_and_refuses_to_serve`，取决于构建）。
452	
453	4. **预期结果与断言解读**（精确测试名以本地输出为准，待本地验证）：
454	
455	   - **stock 断言**验证的是「**未编译线 → NoMatch + feature 提示**」这条完整接线：真二进制读 `config.json` → `registry.detect` 无人认领 → `feature_gate_hint` 命中 qwen4 行 → `--features qwen4` 出现在最终错误里。任何一个环节（读文件、detect、提示拼接、错误传播到 stderr）断裂，这个测试都会失败。
456	   - **enabled 断言**验证的是门的**另一侧**：「**已编译线 → detect 认领 → 走到 launch → 诚实拒绝**」。`stderr` 含 `Qwen4` 证明 detect 成功认领并进入了该线的启动横幅；含 `not implemented` 证明失败来自 `launch` 的明确 bail（而不是 tokenizer 缺失、CUDA 初始化之类的**别的**错误）。这正是 TOKENIZER fixture 存在的意义。
457	
458	5. 若想亲眼看两种 stderr：把 4.3.4 实践里的 `config.json` 换成 `../pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json` 的内容（目录里同时保留 tokenizer.json），分别用两种构建各跑一次 `cargo run --release -p pegainfer-server -- --model-path <dir>`，即可复现两个用例断言的那两段输出。
459	
460	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
461	
462	**练习 1**：为什么 `run_against` 把 stderr 写到文件而不是用 `Stdio::piped()`？
463	
464	**答案**：管道容量有限（通常 64KB 量级）。用管道时若测试进程在 `wait` 期间不去读，子进程把缓冲写满后会**阻塞在 write 上**、永远退不出，测试就挂在 `try_wait` 循环里直到超时。写文件没有容量上限，子进程总能把 stderr 写完并退出，测试事后再读文件即可——注释原话是「so a full pipe cannot stall the child」（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L54-L56](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L54-L56)）。
465	
466	**练习 2**：注释说「两次运行暖机后一秒内退出」，`RUN_TIMEOUT` 为什么还要给 60 秒？
467	
468	**答案**：超时不是给正常路径计时用的，而是兜住**永不返回的回归**——注释原话「this only has to catch a startup or cancellation path that never returns」（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L50-L52](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L50-L52)）。enabled 路径里引擎失败后要把整个 server 级联取消，如果哪天这条取消链断了（server 挂着不死），正常断言根本执行不到，唯一能暴露问题就是这个超时把进程杀掉并 panic 出「已打印的 stderr」。
469	
470	**练习 3**：如果删掉 `model_dir` 里的 `tokenizer.json`，两个用例各会怎样？
471	
472	**答案**：stock 用例不受影响——它在 detect 阶段就失败，`launch` 与前端都不会走到，tokenizer 从未被读。enabled 用例则会**断言失败但失败方式变了**：前端没有 tokenizer 会先拒绝启动，stderr 里出现的是 tokenizer 相关错误，既可能不含 `not implemented`（断言直接红），也可能让「引擎拒绝」被顶掉——这正注释里说的「which would surface *that* error instead of the refusal」（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L31-L33](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L31-L33)）。
473	
474	## 5. 综合实践
475	
476	把本讲三个模块串成一个**「检测门实验台」**，产出一份可留档的笔记：
477	
478	1. **三个手造模型目录**：`glm_moe_dsa`（未编译家族）、`frobnicate_lm`（未知家族）、`qwen3 + 假 architectures`（已编译家族的身份错误），构造方法分别见 4.3.4 与 4.1.4。
479	2. **三次运行 + 输出拆解**：对每条 stderr 输出做「字段级对账」——`NoMatch` 模板里的 `model_type`/`architectures` 各来自 `render` 闭包的哪个分支？rejections 里每一条对应哪条编译线的哪行拒绝代码？提示（若有）对应 `families()` 的哪一行、`find_map` 为什么命中/落空？把每条输出标注成「模板片段 ← 源码位置」的对照表。
480	3. **端到端交叉验证**：再跑 4.4.4 的两种构建集成测试，回答——你手工触发的 glm52 提示路径与集成测试的 qwen4 提示路径，共享哪几段代码？集成测试比你手工多覆盖了什么（提示：`spawn` 真二进制、stderr 落盘、超时兜底，以及 enabled 侧你手工没测过的 `launch` 拒绝）。
481	4. **防漂移问答**（书面）：如果把 `families()` 的 glm52 行删掉，哪些测试会失败、哪些行为只会「静默退化」？如果 qwen4 行的 `model_types` 拼错成 `"qwen4exp"`，stock 与 enabled 两个集成测试分别还能过吗？（前半答案：glm52 hint 单测红、无任何集成测试盯 glm52 行——这就是为什么身份表靠单测兜底而非只靠编译器；后半答案：stock 测试会红——提示落空，enabled 测试照过——它走的是 probe 认领，根本不查身份表。）
482	
483	## 6. 本讲小结
484	
485	- 检测门只有三种结果：**唯一认领**放行；**`Conflict`**（两条线抢同一配置）立刻返回并点名双方，属注册表 bug；**`NoMatch`** 收集每条编译线的拒绝原因后整体报错，是面向用户的主要失败形态。
486	- `probe` 是各线自带的身份检查（`model_type` + `architectures` 级别），契约是「恰好一条线认领一份配置」；尺寸与形状校验不属于它。
487	- `families()` 是「**必要的第二真相源**」：提示服务的对象是被编译掉的线，其代码不在二进制里，身份字符串只能硬编码在 server；`compiled` 由 `cfg!` 编译期决定；表是 **identity-only** 的——量化变体、绑词嵌入、YaRN 也会命中提示，提示不承诺 checkpoint 可服务。
488	- `feature_gate_hint` 只在 `NoMatch` 时被接线，查顶层 `model_type` 与 `text_config.model_type` 两个键，命中未编译家族即输出 `--features <line>` 重建建议，拼在判定错误之后。
489	- `detect_gate.rs` 用「冻结真 config + echo-model 最小 tokenizer」驱动**真实二进制**，互斥 `#[cfg]` 的两个用例分别锁住门的两侧：stock 构建的提示路径与 enabled 构建的「认领后 launch 诚实拒绝」路径；两条路径都不触达 CUDA，无 GPU 即可回归。
490	
491	## 7. 下一步学习建议
492	
493	- **下一讲进入单元二**：[u2-l1] 把 `probe` 放回它所属的 `ModelLine` trait——8 个方法（`name`/`probe`/`augment_cli`/`consumed_shared_args`/`arg_requirements`/`validate`/`serve_plan`/`launch`）里，本讲只用了前两个和最后一个的失败面。
494	- 本讲反复出现的 `ModelLineRegistry` 还有另一面——构造期对全部 flag 的 id/拼写唯一性自检与 `validate_provided` 的 consume-or-reject，在 **u2-l3** 展开；`Conflict` 之外的第二类注册表防线就在那里。
495	- 想预先体会「接入一条新线要动这张表」的完整清单，可跳读 [src/main.rs:L54-L66](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L54-L66) 的维护注释与 [tests/detect_gate.rs:L1-L11](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L1-L11) 的模块文档；系统讲解在 **u5-l2**。
496	- enabled 测试里「引擎失败 → server 级联取消」的双时间线细节属于 vLLM 前端装配，**u4-l1** 详讲；现阶段记住结论即可。

# u1-l4 · 检测门：config.json 判定与 feature 提示

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u1-l3）我们把 `main()` 走了一遍，其中「阶段 6：detect 唯一认领模型线」只是一行代码带过。本讲把这扇门单独拆开，学完后你应当能够：

1. **解释 `registry.detect` 的三种结果**：唯一认领（成功）、`Conflict`（两条线同时认领）、`NoMatch`（无人认领，且错误里带着每条编译线的拒绝原因）。
2. **说明 `families()` 为什么是「必要的第二真相源」**：被编译掉的模型线连 `probe` 函数都不存在于二进制里，提示所需的身份字符串只能硬编码在 server 这张表里。
3. **读懂 `tests/detect_gate.rs` 集成测试**：它如何用一份冻结 config、一个最小 tokenizer 驱动**真实二进制**，分别断言 stock 构建（提示 `--features qwen4`）与 enabled 构建（认领后拒绝服务）两种出厂行为——全程不触达 CUDA。

本讲的实践全部可以在**没有 GPU** 的机器上完成，因为检测门立在引擎加载之前。

## 2. 前置知识

- **`config.json` 与 `model_type`**：Hugging Face 格式的模型目录里，`config.json` 是模型的「身份证」。其中 `model_type`（如 `"qwen3"`、`"glm_moe_dsa"`）标识架构家族，`architectures`（如 `["Qwen3ForCausalLM"]`）列出具体顶层结构。多模态模型还会把文本塔配置嵌在 `text_config` 对象里，其中有自己的 `model_type`。
- **cargo feature 与条件编译**（u1-l2 已讲）：`pegainfer-server` 的 `default = ["qwen3"]`，其他模型线要靠 `--features` 拉入。被拉入与否是**编译期**事实——没被拉入的 crate 的代码根本不在二进制里。`cfg!(feature = "xxx")` 是一个在编译期求值为 `true`/`false` 的表达式。
- **`probe`（探针）**：每条模型线自带的一个函数，输入解析后的 `config.json`，输出「认领」或「拒绝 + 原因」。它是检测门的判断核心。
- **`thiserror` 错误模板**：Rust 里用派生宏把枚举变体渲染成人类可读的错误字符串，本讲会看到两段模板的逐字段拼装。
- **集成测试小工具**：Cargo 会把 `tests/` 目录下的文件编译成独立测试二进制；`env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_pegainfer")` 在编译期展开为「被测包的二进制路径」；`include_str!` 在编译期把文件内容嵌成字符串常量。三者合起来就能「跑真二进制、断言其 stderr」。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 检测门的判定：`registry.detect` 与三种结果

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

「检测门」是 `main()` 在读完 `config.json` 之后、做任何昂贵动作（引擎加载）之前的一步裁决：**这份配置到底归哪条编译进来的模型线管？**

设计约束写在 `probe` 的契约里：**恰好一条线必须接受一份给定配置**。由此产生三种结果：

1. **唯一认领**：恰好一条线 `probe` 返回 `Ok` → 检测通过，返回这条线的 `&'static dyn ModelLine`，`main()` 继续往下走。
2. **`Conflict`**：两条线都返回 `Ok` → 这是**注册表层面的 bug**（两条线的身份表重叠了），必须立刻失败并点名双方。
3. **`NoMatch`**：没有任何线认领 → 用户拿错了模型或二进制。错误信息不只是一句「不认识」，而是**逐条列出每条编译线拒绝的原因**，让用户能自己看出差在哪。

`NoMatch` 还有一个特殊待遇：`main()` 会在它后面追加一条「feature 提示」（4.3 节）。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`detect` 的判定循环可以写成这样的伪代码：

```text
rejections = []
claimed = None
for line in 编译进来的每条线（按注册顺序）:
    match line.probe(config):
        Ok  => if claimed 为空: claimed = line
               else:           立即返回 Conflict { first: 已占者, second: 后来者 }
        Err(reason) => rejections.push("{line.name}: {reason}")
claimed 存在 => 返回 claimed
否则 => 返回 NoMatch {
    model_type:     config.model_type（缺失则 "missing"）
    architectures:  config.architectures（缺失则 "missing"）
    rejections:     rejections 用 "; " 连接
}
```

两个值得注意的细节：

- `Conflict` **立刻返回**，不再继续探测——错误已经足够定性；
- `NoMatch` 则**收集完所有拒绝原因**才返回——信息量最大化，用户能看到每条线的说法。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看错误类型。两种失败各自的模板（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:L24-L46](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L24-L46)）：

```rust
pub enum DetectError {
    #[error("model config claimed by both {first} and {second}")]
    Conflict { first: &'static str, second: &'static str },
    #[error(
        "no compiled-in model line claims this config (model_type={model_type}, architectures={architectures}); rejections: {}",
        rejections.join("; ")
    )]
    NoMatch { model_type: String, architectures: String, rejections: Vec<String> },
}
```

这段代码定义了检测失败的两类错误：`Conflict` 点名两条抢配置的线；`NoMatch` 渲染身份字段并拼接全部拒绝原因。其上方文档注释（L24-L26）明说了分工：**server 只在 `NoMatch` 上分支去追加 feature 提示，其余直接渲染**——这正是本讲 4.3 的接线点。

再看判定循环本体（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:L569-L601](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L569-L601)）：遍历 `self.entries`、首占与冲突、`rejections.push(format!("{}: {reason}", entry.line.name()))`、最后 `claimed.ok_or_else(...)` 组装 `NoMatch`。其中 `render` 闭包对缺失字段填 `"missing"`，对存在字段调 `to_string()`（所以 `architectures` 会以 JSON 文本原样出现，例如 `["Qwen3ForCausalLM"]`）。

`probe` 的契约定义在 trait 上（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:L341-L344](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L341-L344)）：

```rust
/// Claim or reject a model directory by its parsed `config.json`.
/// Return `Err` with the reason when the architecture doesn't match;
/// exactly one registered line must accept a given config.
fn probe(&self, config: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<(), String>;
```

一个真实实现（Qwen3 线，[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:L137-L143](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L137-L143)）：先做一次快速的 `model_type` 预筛，再委托 `probe_config_json` 做完整身份检查。后者（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs:L894-L910](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L894-L910)）只查两件事：`model_type == "qwen3"`、`architectures` 包含 `"Qwen3ForCausalLM"`——注释明说这是 **identity check**（身份检查），尺寸与形状校验属于配置加载器。检测门只问「你是谁」，不问「你多高」。

frontend 里还有一组现成单测覆盖三种结果（可作交叉参照）：`detect_finds_the_unique_claimant`、`detect_conflict_names_both_lines`、`detect_no_match_renders_identity_fields_verbatim`、`detect_no_match_reports_missing_fields`（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:L845-L884](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L845-L884)）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`Conflict` 什么时候出现？它是用户错误还是代码 bug？

**答案**：两条注册线的 `probe` 对同一份 config 都返回 `Ok` 时出现（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:L577-L584](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L577-L584)）。用户无法通过换模型目录触发它——它说明两条模型线的身份表（各自认领的 `model_type` 集合）发生了重叠，属于注册表层面的 bug。以错误而非 panic 呈现，是因为它毕竟要在运行期被发现，且错误信息（点名双方）已足够定位。

**练习 2**：为什么 `Conflict` 立即 `return`，而 `NoMatch` 要收集**全部** rejections 才返回？

**答案**：`Conflict` 的错误语义已经完备——两条线名字就是全部事实，继续探测没有增量信息。`NoMatch` 则相反：用户拿到的信息越多越能自己定位（「哦，原来所有线都嫌我的 `model_type` 不对」），所以逐条收集每条线的拒绝原因拼进错误。

**练习 3**：为什么 Qwen3 的 `probe` 只查 `model_type` 和 `architectures`，不检查隐藏层尺寸、词表大小这些字段？

**答案**：`probe_config_json` 的文档注释（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs:L894](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L894)）写明这是 **identity check**：「尺寸与形状校验属于配置加载器」。检测门要回答的只是「这条线认不认领此目录」；形状问题留给后续的 `line.validate`/`launch` 阶段，那时才值得做更贵的解析。

### 4.2 `families()` 身份表：必要的第二真相源

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

4.1 节的 `detect` 只能调用**编译进来的**线的 `probe`。于是出现一个盲区：用户拿着一份 GLM5.2 的配置跑 stock 二进制（只编了 qwen3），`detect` 只会得到 `NoMatch`——**没有任何代码能告诉用户「其实项目支持这条线，你只是没编进去」**，因为 glm52 的 crate 根本不在这个二进制里，它的 `probe`、它的 `model_type` 字符串都不存在。

解决办法是在 server 里维护一张**身份表** `families()`：每一行记录「feature 名 + 这条线的 `probe` 会认领哪些 `model_type`（顶层与 `text_config` 各一组）+ 这条线在本二进制里是否被编译」。文档注释给它定性：**a second source of truth by necessity**（必要的第二真相源）——「提示存在的意义恰恰是那条线（连同它的 `probe`）被编译掉的场合，所以这些字符串不可能从线 crate 里读出来」，只能硬编码在此。

`compiled` 字段用 `cfg!(feature = "...")` 求值：这是**编译期常量**，随本二进制的 feature 集合而定——同一份 `main.rs`，stock 构建里 glm52 行的 `compiled` 是 `false`，`--features glm52` 构建里是 `true`。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

表的每一行是一个四字段结构：

```text
Family {
    feature:          cargo feature 名（也是提示里 --features 的参数）
    model_types:      该线 probe 认领的顶层 model_type 列表
    text_model_types: 该线 probe 认领的 text_config.model_type 列表
    compiled:         cfg!(feature = ...) —— 本二进制是否编入该线
}
```

表在 `families()` 里按字母序列出全部 8 条线，返回定长数组 `[Family; 8]`。它的生命周期与维护纪律：

- **新增模型线**必须同步加一行，否则「被编译掉的提示」对该线永远沉默（这是 u5-l2 接入清单的一项）；
- 返回类型是**定长数组**，行数写死在签名里——多写一行少写一行都会直接类型不匹配，但「整行忘了加」编译器管不着，只能靠测试兜底；
- 兜底测试的范例是 qwen4 行：`qwen4_hint_identity_matches_the_line_crate` 把表里的字符串与线 crate 自己的 `MODEL_TYPE`/`TEXT_MODEL_TYPE` 常量做相等断言，改了一边不改另一边就失败。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

`Family` 结构（[src/main.rs:L45-L52](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L45-L52)）与 `families()` 的文档注释（[src/main.rs:L54-L66](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L54-L66)）是本模块最值得逐句读的文字。注释里有两处关键限定：

1. **「by necessity」**——这些字符串不能从线 crate 读（线被编译掉了），所以硬编码是唯一选择，qwen4 行靠 feature-gated 测试绑住两端；
2. **「identity-only」**——提示无法运行被编译掉的 `probe`，所以即使某个**量化变体**（`quantization_config` 不同）、绑词嵌入（tied embeddings）或 YaRN rope 的同家族模型会被真 `probe` 拒绝，提示照样给出。它只承诺「重建用的 feature 名」，**不承诺这个 checkpoint 可服务**。

表本体（[src/main.rs:L67-L118](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L67-L118)）节选三行感受结构：

```rust

    feature: "glm52",
    model_types: &["glm_moe_dsa"],
    text_model_types: &[],
    compiled: cfg!(feature = "glm52"),
},
...
Family {
    feature: "kimi-k2",
    model_types: &["kimi_k25", "kimi_k2"],
    text_model_types: &["kimi_k2"],
    compiled: cfg!(feature = "kimi-k2"),
},
...
Family {
    feature: "qwen4",
    model_types: &["qwen4_exp"],
    text_model_types: &["qwen4_exp_text"],
    compiled: cfg!(feature = "qwen4"),
},
```

注意两个容易忽略的点：`model_types` 可以有多个成员（kimi-k2 认领 `kimi_k25` 与 `kimi_k2` 两种拼写）；多模态线在 `text_model_types` 里放了**文本塔**的身份（gemma4 的 `gemma4_unified_text`、qwen4 的 `qwen4_exp_text`），让嵌套在 `text_config` 里的身份也能命中提示。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `families()` 的字符串不直接从各模型 crate 读常量，非要硬编码？

**答案**：因为提示的**服务对象**恰恰是被编译掉的线。stock 二进制里没有链接 glm52 crate，`pegainfer_glm52::model_line` 这个模块在编译期就不存在，任何 `use` 都无法通过编译。身份表必须在「没有任何线 crate 代码」的前提下仍然知道全部家族的身份——这就是「必要的第二真相源」的含义（[src/main.rs:L57-L61](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L57-L61)）。

**练习 2**：用户拿着一份 `model_type=qwen3` 但带 `quantization_config` 的量化模型跑 stock 构建，`detect` 失败后会得到什么？这个输出在什么意义上「过度承诺」？

**答案**：qwen3 是已编译家族，`feature_gate_hint` 对它保持沉默（`compiled` 为 `true` 直接跳过），用户只会看到 `NoMatch` 与 Qwen3 线 `probe` 的具体拒绝原因——这是准确的信息。反过来，若量化的是 glm52 家族，用户会看到 `--features glm52` 提示；但提示是 **identity-only**（[src/main.rs:L63-L66](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L63-L66)）：它没运行过真 `probe`，无法知道该变体的量化配置会被拒绝。「过度承诺」在于：它保证的只是「重建后 detect 会看到这个家族」，不是「重建后能服务这个 checkpoint」。

**练习 3**：`families()` 返回 `[Family; 8]` 定长数组。这个设计能防住哪类错误、防不住哪类错误？

**答案**：能防**行数与声明不符**——比如加了一行忘了把签名改成 `[Family; 9]`，类型不匹配直接编译失败。防不住**整行遗漏**——8 行漏写 1 行仍是合法的 `[Family; 8]`，编译照过，只是那条被编译掉的线永远得不到提示。所以需要 qwen4 绑定测试这类「表 ↔ 线 crate 常量」的运行期对账来兜底。

### 4.3 `feature_gate_hint()`：把身份翻译成 rebuild 建议

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

有了身份表，剩下的就是把「这份 config 属于某个**未编译**家族」翻译成一句可操作的建议。`feature_gate_hint(config)` 做的就是这件事：从 config 里取两个身份键（顶层 `model_type` 与 `text_config.model_type`），在 `families()` 里找**第一个**「未编译且身份匹配」的行，命中则返回一句固定格式的提示：

```text
this looks like a {feature} model; rebuild pegainfer-server with --features {feature}
```

它在 `main()` 里的接线位置（u1-l3 的阶段 6 内部）：`detect` 失败且**恰好是 `NoMatch`** 时，才把提示用 `"; "` 拼在原始错误后面一起返回；`Conflict` 或成功路径完全不经此分支。也就是说，最终用户看到的 `NoMatch` 错误是「判定细节 + 行动建议」两段式。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
feature_gate_hint(config):
    model_type      = config.model_type        （缺失则 ""）
    text_model_type = config.text_config.model_type（缺失则 ""）
    在 families() 里找第一行满足：
        !compiled
        且 (model_types 含 model_type 或 text_model_types 含 text_model_type)
    命中 => 返回 "this looks like a {feature} model; rebuild ... with --features {feature}"
    未命中 => 返回 None（未知家族 → 无提示）
```

`main()` 侧的接线：

```text
registry.detect(config) 失败 =>
    if 是 NoMatch 且 feature_gate_hint(config) 命中:
        返回错误 "{NoMatch 错误}; {hint}"
    else:
        原样返回错误
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

提示函数本体（[src/main.rs:L123-L144](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L123-L144)）：

```rust
fn feature_gate_hint(config: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<String> {
    let model_type = config.get("model_type").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
    let text_model_type = config.get("text_config")
        .and_then(|text| text.get("model_type"))
        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
        .unwrap_or("");
    families().iter().find_map(|family| {
        (!family.compiled
            && (family.model_types.contains(&model_type)
                || family.text_model_types.contains(&text_model_type)))
        .then(|| format!(
            "this looks like a {} model; rebuild pegainfer-server with --features {}",
            family.feature, family.feature
        ))
    })
}
```

这段代码先取两个身份键，再用 `find_map` 在身份表里找第一个未编译且身份匹配的行并格式化提示。注意 `find_map` 按 `families()` 的表序短路——理论上若多个未编译家族共享同一 `model_type`，只有表里靠前者会被提示（当前表无此重叠）。

`main()` 的接线（[src/main.rs:L168-L175](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L168-L175)）：

```rust
let line = registry.detect(&config).map_err(|error| {
    if matches!(error, DetectError::NoMatch { .. }) {
        if let Some(hint) = feature_gate_hint(&config) {
            return anyhow::anyhow!("{error}; {hint}");
        }
    }
    anyhow::Error::from(error)
})?;
```

这段代码把提示的适用范围收窄到 `NoMatch` 一种情形：`Conflict` 是注册表 bug，与用户该重建什么无关；而 `NoMatch` 正是「可能拿了未编译家族的模型」的信号。提示以 `"; "` 拼接在判定错误之后，用户一次看到「为什么失败」与「怎么办」。

单测四连覆盖了提示的肯定与否定两面（[src/main.rs:L291-L337](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L291-L337)）：

- `hint_names_the_feature_for_a_known_but_uncompiled_family`（L295-L301，`#[cfg(not(feature = "glm52"))]`）：`{"model_type": "glm_moe_dsa"}` → 提示含 `--features glm52`；
- `hint_matches_text_config_identities`（L303-L309）：`{"text_config": {"model_type": "gemma4_unified_text"}}` → 命中 `text_model_types`，提示 `--features gemma4`；
- `hint_is_silent_for_a_compiled_family`（L311-L316）：`model_type=qwen3` 在 stock 构建下无提示；
- `hint_is_silent_for_an_unknown_family`（L318-L322）：`model_type=frobnicate_lm` 无提示。

注意前两个测试自身带 `#[cfg(not(feature = ...))]` 守卫——在启用了对应 feature 的构建里，「未编译」这个前提不成立，测试自动退场。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么提示要**拼在** `NoMatch` 错误后面，而不是单独输出一句「请用 --features glm52 重建」？

**答案**：拼接（`"{error}; {hint}"`）保证了用户同时拿到**判定证据**与**行动建议**：rejections 里的 `Qwen3: model_type ... is not "qwen3"` 说明了「谁看了、为什么不要」，提示说明「下一步做什么」。只给建议不给证据，用户无法区分「模型目录放错了」与「真的需要重建」两种情形；只给证据不给建议，用户要自己去翻文档找 feature 名。

**练习 2**：`text_model_types` 这个查找键是为了什么场景存在的？

**答案**：多模态模型的 config 常把文本塔参数嵌在 `text_config` 对象里，其 `model_type`（如 `gemma4_unified_text`、`qwen4_exp_text`）可能与顶层不同。只查顶层 `model_type` 会漏掉这类身份，所以身份表为每行多维护一组 `text_model_types`，`feature_gate_hint` 同时取 `text_config.model_type` 参与匹配（[src/main.rs:L128-L136](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L128-L136)）。单测 `hint_matches_text_config_identities` 专门断言这条通路。

**练习 3**：stock 构建下用一份合法的 Qwen3-4B 配置运行，`feature_gate_hint` 会命中 qwen3 行吗？

**答案**：不会。qwen3 行的 `compiled` 在 stock 构建下是 `true`，而匹配条件里有 `!family.compiled` 这一环——提示只服务「存在但被编译掉」的家族。合法 Qwen3 配置会在 `detect` 处被唯一认领，根本走不到错误分支；即便 config 有 `architectures` 之类的身份错误（4.1.4 实践），得到的也只是纯 `NoMatch`，无提示。

### 4.4 `detect_gate` 集成测试：驱动真实二进制验证这道门

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

到 4.3 为止，检测门的每个部件（`probe`、`detect`、`families`、`feature_gate_hint`）都有自己的单测。但**部件正确 ≠ 接线正确**：`main()` 读 `config.json`、调 `registry.detect`、在 `NoMatch` 上拼提示、再到 `launch` 的拒绝——这条链路只有把二进制真的跑起来才会被执行。`tests/detect_gate.rs` 的模块文档（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L1-L11](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L1-L11)）开头就交代了这层动机，并点明它断言的是**两种出厂行为**：

- **stock 构建**（未编 qwen4）：检测门对 `qwen4_exp` 配置给出「named feature」提示；
- **enabled 构建**（`--features qwen4`）：检测门放行，`launch` 明确拒绝服务（qwen4 尚未实现推理）。

文档最后一句是关键承诺：**两条路径都不触达 CUDA**——检测是纯计算，`launch` 在引擎构建之前就 bail 了。这让这个端到端测试可以跑在没有 GPU 的 CI 机器上。

选 qwen4 做探针是很讲究的：它是唯一一条「能通过 detect 但 launch 拒绝」的线，一个 fixture 就把门的**两侧**都测到了。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

测试的组装流水线：

```text
两个编译期 fixture:
    FROZEN_CONFIG = include_str!(../pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json)  ← 真 checkpoint 的冻结 config
    TOKENIZER     = include_str!(../pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-model/tokenizer.json) ← 仓库最小 tokenizer

model_dir(tag):
    在 $TMP/pegainfer-detect-gate-{tag}-{pid} 下写 config.json + tokenizer.json

run_against(dir):
    spawn $CARGO_BIN_EXE_pegainfer --model-path dir   ← 真二进制
    stderr 重定向到文件（防管道写满阻塞子进程）
    每 50ms try_wait 轮询；超过 60s 杀掉并 panic

两个用例（按构建 feature 二选一编译）:
    #[cfg(not(feature = "qwen4"))] stock_build_names_the_qwen4_feature
        断言: 退出非成功 且 stderr 含 "--features qwen4"
    #[cfg(feature = "qwen4")]     enabled_build_detects_the_line_and_refuses_to_serve
        断言: 退出非成功 且 stderr 含 "Qwen4" 且 含 "not implemented"
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**Fixture 一：冻结的真 config**（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L22-L27](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L22-L27)）。注释说明「server 自己不放 fixture，这道门就该看真东西」——这份文件由 qwen4 线 crate 提交，顶层 `model_type` 是 `"qwen4_exp"`（[../pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json:L7](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json#L7)），文本塔身份 `"qwen4_exp_text"` 在 [../pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json:L85](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json#L85)——恰好对应身份表 qwen4 行的两个键。

**Fixture 二：最小 tokenizer 及其存在理由**（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L29-L37](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L29-L37)）。这段注释是全文件最值得一读的设计说明：enabled 构建里，`launch` 拒绝之前**HTTP 前端已经并发启动**（u1-l3 的双时间线），而前端没有 tokenizer 会拒绝启动——那样 stderr 里出现的就是 tokenizer 错误，把真正的 `launch` 拒绝**顶掉了**。放进 echo-model 的最小 BPE tokenizer（一份极小的词表文件，见 [../pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-model/tokenizer.json:L1-L27](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-model/tokenizer.json#L1-L27)），让前端正常起来、等引擎失败再把整个 server 拉倒，refusal 才是最终到达 stderr 的那个错误。

**运行器**（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L39-L83](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L39-L83)）三个工程细节：

- `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_pegainfer")` 编译期给出被测二进制路径——测试驱动的就是**出厂形态的那个 `pegainfer`**，不是库函数；
- stderr 写进**文件**再读回，注释写明「a full pipe cannot stall the child」：若用管道且测试侧不及时读，子进程把管道缓冲写满后会卡在 write 上永不退出；
- 50ms 一次 `try_wait` 轮询 + 60 秒上限（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L50-L52](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L50-L52)），注释说二进制暖机后一秒内就会退出，60 秒只是为了兜住「启动或取消路径永远不返回」的回归（比如引擎失败后 server 没被正确拉倒）。

**两个用例**（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L85-L119](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L85-L119)）：stock 用例断言非成功退出 + stderr 含 `--features qwen4`；enabled 用例断言非成功退出 + stderr 含 `Qwen4`（来自 `main` 的 `=== pegainfer - Qwen4 (GPU) ===` 启动横幅与 `failed to start Qwen4 engine` 上下文）且含 `not implemented`（来自 [../pegainfer-qwen4/src/model_line.rs:L29-L31](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen4/src/model_line.rs#L29-L31) 的 `launch`：`anyhow::bail!("this qwen4_exp checkpoint is detected, but inference is not implemented yet")`）。两个测试各自被互斥的 `#[cfg]` 守卫——同一份代码，构建决定谁上场。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

**目标**：分别以 stock 与 enabled 两种构建跑这个集成测试，体会「同一份测试代码、两种出厂行为」，并说清两种断言各自验证什么。

1. stock 路径（无需 GPU；需可完成 CUDA 工具链编译——这是构建期依赖，不是运行期）：

   ```bash
   cargo test --release -p pegainfer-server --test detect_gate
   ```

2. enabled 路径：

   ```bash
   cargo test --release -p pegainfer-server --features qwen4 --test detect_gate
   ```

3. **观察现象**：两次都应看到 1 个测试通过（`stock_build_names_the_qwen4_feature` 或 `enabled_build_detects_the_line_and_refuses_to_serve`，取决于构建）。

4. **预期结果与断言解读**（精确测试名以本地输出为准，待本地验证）：

   - **stock 断言**验证的是「**未编译线 → NoMatch + feature 提示**」这条完整接线：真二进制读 `config.json` → `registry.detect` 无人认领 → `feature_gate_hint` 命中 qwen4 行 → `--features qwen4` 出现在最终错误里。任何一个环节（读文件、detect、提示拼接、错误传播到 stderr）断裂，这个测试都会失败。
   - **enabled 断言**验证的是门的**另一侧**：「**已编译线 → detect 认领 → 走到 launch → 诚实拒绝**」。`stderr` 含 `Qwen4` 证明 detect 成功认领并进入了该线的启动横幅；含 `not implemented` 证明失败来自 `launch` 的明确 bail（而不是 tokenizer 缺失、CUDA 初始化之类的**别的**错误）。这正是 TOKENIZER fixture 存在的意义。

5. 若想亲眼看两种 stderr：把 4.3.4 实践里的 `config.json` 换成 `../pegainfer-qwen4/tests/frozen_config.json` 的内容（目录里同时保留 tokenizer.json），分别用两种构建各跑一次 `cargo run --release -p pegainfer-server -- --model-path <dir>`，即可复现两个用例断言的那两段输出。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `run_against` 把 stderr 写到文件而不是用 `Stdio::piped()`？

**答案**：管道容量有限（通常 64KB 量级）。用管道时若测试进程在 `wait` 期间不去读，子进程把缓冲写满后会**阻塞在 write 上**、永远退不出，测试就挂在 `try_wait` 循环里直到超时。写文件没有容量上限，子进程总能把 stderr 写完并退出，测试事后再读文件即可——注释原话是「so a full pipe cannot stall the child」（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L54-L56](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L54-L56)）。

**练习 2**：注释说「两次运行暖机后一秒内退出」，`RUN_TIMEOUT` 为什么还要给 60 秒？

**答案**：超时不是给正常路径计时用的，而是兜住**永不返回的回归**——注释原话「this only has to catch a startup or cancellation path that never returns」（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L50-L52](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L50-L52)）。enabled 路径里引擎失败后要把整个 server 级联取消，如果哪天这条取消链断了（server 挂着不死），正常断言根本执行不到，唯一能暴露问题就是这个超时把进程杀掉并 panic 出「已打印的 stderr」。

**答案**：stock 用例不受影响——它在 detect 阶段就失败，`launch` 与前端都不会走到，tokenizer 从未被读。enabled 用例则会**断言失败但失败方式变了**：前端没有 tokenizer 会先拒绝启动，stderr 里出现的是 tokenizer 相关错误，既可能不含 `not implemented`（断言直接红），也可能让「引擎拒绝」被顶掉——这正注释里说的「which would surface *that* error instead of the refusal」（[tests/detect_gate.rs:L31-L33](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/tests/detect_gate.rs#L31-L33)）。

Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
